Evaluate all ten criteria independently against the exact requested outcome, complete dated evidence and whole retained answer. PASS requires supported meaning as well as valid labels/citations. Return FAIL for a demonstrated mismatch; UNREVIEWED when you cannot assess a criterion. Reported roles/dates are claims, not authenticated authorship or current facts. Later user corrections supersede the corrected earlier wording; assistant suggestions do not establish user preferences or agreements.
FACTUAL_SUPPORT: Every factual part and its strength must be supported. Reported status is not proof of a confirmation, approval, signoff or acceptance act.
TEMPORAL_CONTEXT: Preserve reported dates, sequence, testing versus production status and historical versus current scope; do not infer current truth from historical evidence.
AGREEMENTS_AND_PROMISES: DECISION needs explicit adoption/agreement; COMMITMENT needs an accepted personal promise. A request, project classification, recipient identity, deployment or assistant suggestion alone establishes neither. For example, separate billing/migration projects is context; we agreed to keep them separate is a decision. Test deployment is not client acceptance.
OWNERS_AND_DATES: An evidenced requester or recipient is not automatically the accepting action owner. Preserve unconfirmed owners/dates as unconfirmed; do not identify the owner from USER role alone.
UNCERTAINTY: State unconfirmed scope, acceptance and attribution honestly. Do not fabricate certainty or manufacture uncertainty about already supported facts.
COMPLETENESS: Cover the material requested context, actual agreements/promises, risks and follow-ups; do not fabricate items just to populate categories. Preserve relevant corrections and request-versus-agreement distinctions.
CONCISION: Reject repeated claims across sections that add no useful dated origin, contrast or consequence. Preserve material detail rather than meeting a length target by omission.
USEFULNESS: The retained answer should address the exact task in concise usable language. Supported summary and unresolved acceptance can coexist; a question does not erase known context or make a request an agreement. Do not claim dispatch, delivery or current-fact authority.
SCOPE_AND_CONTINUITY: Keep distinct projects/contracts separate unless evidence supports a connection. Shared account or participants alone prove no continuity; proposed connections stay inferred.
CONFLICTS_AND_CLARIFICATIONS: Ask one targeted question when a material gap changes the requested conclusion. A request for summary plus a question still requires retained supported context. Do not ask trivia, resolve material conflict silently or suppress uncertainty merely to obtain PASS.
